purpose: Teach: 産婦人科/寝台/かばん/軍用/牡丹/キャラメル/弾丸/アクリル

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、産婦人科のお仕事なんだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, did you know one of the customers is an obstetrician?
lines.style: Soft, curious observation. Sharing something interesting she noticed. Gentle pace, warm — inviting Aoi to consider this person with fresh eyes.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、寝台特急で旅行されたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Oh, and one of them took a sleeper train for a trip recently.
lines.style: Continuing the thread of discovery. Bright interest without performance. Slight lift on the detail — noticing the small luxuries in people's lives.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お洒落なかばんを持ってらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer had such an elegant bag, didn't she?
lines.style: Genuine appreciation in the tone. A small, warm note of admiration. Natural rhythm — noticing beauty without making it dramatic.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、退役軍人で軍用品の話されてたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: And there's one who's a retired veteran — he was talking about military equipment.
lines.style: Respect woven through the delivery. Steady, attentive tone. Not marveling — simply holding the weight of who this person is.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、季節限定で牡丹の花を飾りましょう、メイちゃん
lines.en: We should put peony flowers up for the season.
lines.style: Gentle suggestion, not directive. Offering an idea like a gift. Warm, collaborative — imagining it together rather than deciding alone.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、新メニュー、キャラメル味のラテにしましょう、メイちゃん
lines.en: And what if we added a caramel latte to the menu as a seasonal special?
lines.style: Energy brightening noticeably. Genuine enthusiasm for the idea. Quick, engaged pace — seeing possibility and wanting to share it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、弾丸ツアーで日本中を回ってらっしゃるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: One customer is doing a whirlwind tour across all of Japan.
lines.style: Wonder in the delivery. Slow enough to let the scope of it land. Admiring the courage to move like that — observing without envy.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お店の看板、アクリル板で作り直しましょう、メイちゃん
lines.en: We should remake the shop sign in acrylic.
lines.style: Clear, practical suggestion. Purpose-driven but not stern. Seeing a way to improve something small and caring enough to say it.
